description: Set how your listings ship: the shipping price per unit, or that shipping is quoted per order, and the lot type (parcel, pallet, truckload or mixed). Optionally set where your stock ships from; that is part of your seller account and shows on all your listings. Requires sign-in with seller access. Up to 200 of your listings per call; every id must be yours or nothing changes. shipping_price_cents is charged per unit at checkout (0 means free shipping). quote_shipping=true removes the fixed price so buyers ask for a quote, and turns off instant checkout on those listings, because instant checkout needs a fixed shipping price. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:write). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

lot_type.description: How the lot ships: parcel (boxes by courier), pallet, truckload, or mixed.

product_ids.description: Your ForthClear product ids (max 200 per call).

quote_shipping.description: true: no fixed shipping price; buyers request a quote that includes shipping. Turns off instant checkout on these listings. Not with shipping_price_cents.

ship_from_country.description: Two-letter country code your stock ships from, for example US. Applies to your whole seller account.

ship_from_region.description: Optional state or region your stock ships from, for example Michigan. Applies to your whole seller account. Only with ship_from_country.

shipping_price_cents.description: Shipping price per unit in cents, charged per unit at checkout. 0 means free shipping. Not with quote_shipping.

name: set_listing_shipping
title: Set listing shipping
